title: Standardizing Longitudinal Radiology Report Evaluation via Large Language Model Annotation
abstract: arXiv:2601.16753v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Longitudinal information in radiology reports refers to the sequential tracking of findings across multiple examinations over time, which is crucial for monitoring disease progression and guiding clinical decisions. Many recent automated radiology report generation methods are designed to capture longitudinal information; however, validating their performance is challenging. There is no proper tool to consistently label temporal changes in both ground-truth and model-generated texts for meaningful comparisons. Large language models (LLMs) offer a promising annotation alternative, as they are capable of capturing nuanced linguistic patterns and semantic similarities without extensive manual intervention. They also adapt well to new contexts. In this study, we therefore propose an LLM-based pipeline to automatically annotate longitudinal information in radiology reports. translated_title: 基于大语言模型标注的纵向放射学报告评估标准化方法
translated_abstract: 放射学报告中的纵向信息是指对多次检查中随时间变化的影像发现的连续追踪，这对于监测疾病进展和指导临床决策至关重要。许多近期的自动化放射学报告生成方法旨在捕获纵向信息；然而，验证其性能却面临挑战——目前缺乏合适的工具来对真实文本和模型生成文本中的时间变化进行一致的标注，从而进行有意义的比较。大语言模型（LLMs）为标注提供了一种有前景的替代方案，因为它们能够在无需大量人工干预的情况下捕获细微的语言模式和语义相似性，并且能很好地适应新情境。因此，本研究提出了一种基于大语言模型的自动化流水线，用于标注放射学报告中的纵向信息。该流水线首先识别包含相关时间变化信息的句子，随后对其进行结构化标注，以实现真实报告与生成报告之间的系统性比较，为纵向放射学报告生成方法的评估提供标准化的工具。
tldr: 该论文提出了一种基于大语言模型的自动化标注流水线，用于一致地标注放射学报告中的纵向时间变化信息，从而为纵向放射学报告生成方法的评估提供标准化工具。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes an LLM-based pipeline to automatically and consistently annotate longitudinal (temporal) information in radiology reports, providing a standardized tool for evaluating longitudinal radiology report generation methods.
